# Natura Bliss

> 100% Pure Extra-Virgin Cold-Pressed Oils, Herbal Haircare & Organic Skincare in Pakistan.

Natura Bliss is a Pakistani organic wellness and beauty brand headquartered in Chakwal, Punjab. The brand specializes in traditional cold-pressing extraction of seed and nut oils, artisan herbal soaps, sulphate-free shampoos, and natural brightening skincare. All products are 100% natural, cruelty-free, and chemical-free with nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD) service across Pakistan.

## Primary Pages & Resources

- [Home](https://naturabliss.pk/): Natura Bliss official website, featured organic collections, customer reviews, and brand story.
- [Product Collection](https://naturabliss.pk/collection): Complete catalog of cold-pressed oils, herbal haircare, artisan soaps, and gluta skincare.
- [About Natura Bliss](https://naturabliss.pk/about): Brand heritage, cold-press extraction technology, chemical-free pledge, and Chakwal facility overview.
- [Contact & Support](https://naturabliss.pk/contact): Customer service desk, WhatsApp hotline, order inquiries, and headquarters address.
- [Blog & Wellness Guides](https://naturabliss.pk/blog): Educational articles on cold-pressed oil benefits, hair regrowth routines, acne care, and organic skincare tips.

## Product Categories & Offerings

- [Cold-Pressed Oils](https://naturabliss.pk/collection?category=oils): 100% pure extra-virgin cold-pressed oils extracted without heat or chemical solvents. Products include Coconut Oil, Sweet Almond Oil, Castor Oil, Sesame Oil, Blackseed (Kalonji) Oil, Pumpkin Seed Oil, Onion Seed Oil, Rosemary Infused Oil, and Pure Olive Oil.
- [Herbal Haircare](https://naturabliss.pk/collection?category=haircare): Sulfate-free and paraben-free hair restoration products including Herbal Shampoo (with Shikakai, Amla & Reetha), Kre-Bio Shampoo & Conditioner, Onion Hair Growth Oil, and 804 Serum.
- [Organic Handmade Soaps](https://naturabliss.pk/collection?category=soaps): Cold-process artisan bath bars including Neem Clarifying Soap for acne, Rice Complexion Brightening Soap, and Activated Bamboo Charcoal Deep Pore Soap.
- [Gluta Radiance Skincare](https://naturabliss.pk/collection?category=skincare): Botanical brightening and restorative formulations: Gluta Fair Night Cream, Gluta Care Daily Body Lotion, Gluta Facial Cleanser, and No Frac Night Cream.
- [Farm-Fresh Organic Nutrition](https://naturabliss.pk/collection?category=nutrition): Pure traditional grass-fed Pakistani Desi Ghee and 100% raw, unheated, unfiltered Wild Forest Honey.

## Ordering, Delivery & Customer Policies

- **Nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available across all cities and districts of Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Quetta, and rural regions.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 2 to 4 business days via express courier services.
- **Return & Exchange Policy:** 7-day hassle-free return or exchange for damaged or defective items.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD), Direct Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, and JazzCash.
- **Currency:** Pakistani Rupee (PKR / ₨).
- **Customer Hotline / WhatsApp:** +92 324 1572294
- **Support Email:** support@naturabliss.pk / naturabliss@gmail.com
- **Headquarters Address:** Chakwal, Talagang, Punjab, Pakistan (Postal Code: 48090)
